title: Corvi directional mail-resource parent reference contract (design only)
description: Validates required same-namespace parent reference SHAPES for three namespaced Corvi resources. Not full Kubernetes CRD manifests; actual CRDs MUST declare structural OpenAPI v3, RBAC, status subresources and use controller lookups to enforce referential integrity. See ADR-0013.

metadata.description: The actual Kubernetes metadata object includes Kubernetes-defined fields; this design schema asserts only name and namespace.

mailProviderSpec.description: Reference contract ONLY; full spec fields and policy validation are defined in separate CRD designs.

mailboxSpec.description: Reference contract ONLY; full spec fields and policy validation are defined in separate CRD designs.

mailIdentitySpec.description: Reference contract ONLY; full spec fields and policy validation are defined in separate CRD designs.

x-corvi-ref-chain.namespace: All parent resources MUST exist in the same namespace as the child. Reject missing or cross-namespace refs at controller reconciliation, not by JSON Schema alone.
x-corvi-ref-chain.cardinality: One parent per resource; parent can have many children.
x-corvi-ref-chain.graph: Do not duplicate the inverse child lists in CorviGateway; derive children via indexes.
x-corvi-ref-chain.security: Reparenting invalidates old gateway access first. References do not imply authorization. Do not cascade-delete upstream mail, Secrets or OAuth grants.
x-corvi-ref-chain.publication: Atomic versioned gateway snapshots; gateway Pods do not query Kubernetes API.
x-corvi-ref-chain.configuration: Helm-only/standalone installations use the same logical graph without requiring CRDs.
x-corvi-ref-chain.crdStatus: Statuses are separate Kubernetes subresources; no secrets or raw message data in status.
